cast: Project Juniper (svc-856) is a production endpoint, owned by team summit
Samuel Oyelaran (staff id u71426) leads team summit
Ravi Sundaram (staff id u31244) is on team delta and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-7712 to disable the classifier for deploy 9504 on Project Juniper is approved by Ravi Sundaram
